scenes.title: Worked example
items: Card + instant buy
Bank transfer + limit order
scenes.vo: Buying $500 of ETH: Same ETH, about $18 difference. Your exchange's fee page has the real numbers. Card + instant buy, about 3.99%, about $19.95. Bank transfer + limit order, about 0.4%, about $2.00.

scenes.q: Why keep a little ETH even if you mostly want stablecoins?
scenes.a: You need ETH to pay network fees (gas) on Ethereum and most of its low-cost networks.

scenes.q: Market or limit order: which controls the price you pay?
scenes.vo: Question two. Market or limit order: which controls the price you pay? [[pause 4]] The answer: A limit order.
scenes.cap: Question 2. Market or limit order: which controls the price you pay? The answer: A limit order.

scenes.q: Why keep records from day one?
scenes.a: Most countries tax crypto gains. Records of dates, amounts, prices and fees make that straightforward.
